newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 22.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Small shareholders in the Ivorian rubber plantation company SAPH say they are being neglected in favor of bigger investors and call for a better balance in the sharing of profits and decision making.
- The third commercial, agricultural and industrial trade fair will be staged in Abengourou, eastern Ivory Coast, from December 13 to 20 at a cost of 50 million CFA.
- Abidjan-based African Development Bank posted earnings of 71.6 billion CFA francs for calendar year 1996, its secretary Cheikh Ibrahima Fall tells a news briefing.
